# Archetype Agent Vault

> Modular library of character-driven, production-tested AI agent personas & suites (`waste-management`, `trojan-janitor`, `zero-mercy-gatekeeper`, `booby-trap-defender`, `casting-director`, and more) built to work with any LLM.

## Agent Entry Points (All Models)
- `AGENTS.md` — Universal project guardrails, Rule of 2, and concurrency cap.
- `HANDOFF.md` — Active session state, verification command, and next step.
- `mistakes.md` — Permanent "Never Repeat" guardrail log.

## Key Paths
- `waste-management/` — Orchestrator ("The Boss") archetype.
- `trojan-janitor/` — Ingestion, cleanup & dead-link purge archetype.
- `zero-mercy-gatekeeper/` — Strict QA, typecheck & spec enforcement archetype.
- `booby-trap-defender/` — Security & edge-case defense archetype.
- `casting-director/` — Multi-agent team assembly archetype.
- `laid-back-simplifier/` — Complexity reduction & lightweight refactor archetype.
- `paranoia-pack/`, `redacted-veteran/`, `crossover-starter/` — Specialized audit & starter suites.
- `scripts/` — Setup & installation helpers.

## Verification Command
`ls -la AGENTS.md HANDOFF.md mistakes.md llms.txt`
